title: 41° North Coastal Adventures

services.name: Kayak & SUP Classes
services.desc: Whether you are a beginner looking to get started or an experienced paddler looking to improve their skills in more challenging conditions, our professionally certified instructors can help you achieve your goals. Our programs include all the equipment you need to safely enjoy your time on the water. Learn more about each of our classes below. Click the button for the classes you’re looking for, or browse all our selections! Join one of our kayak or SUP classes and build the skills and confidence to safely paddle our region’s waterways.
